correctness.rationale: The exact Hamiltonian identity H/J=2s²−n+(κ−1)(n−2k)−2ts follows from pair signs. Feasible k satisfy 0≤k≤n−|s| and k≡n−|s| modulo 2. Minimization selects k minimum (κ<1), maximum (κ>1), or all (κ=1). Explicit pair enumeration gives the sector counts; strictly ordered adjacent crossings for κ>0 and paired crossings for κ=0 establish exhaustive global minimizers. At fixed field, minimizing |s| is bounded and Stirling estimates yield entropy. An independent exhaustive Hamiltonian enumerator confirms 714 finite instances, but analytical reasoning supplies the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural two-coupling graph deformation (missing matching to ordinary complete graph to pair-dominated) is classified at all sizes and fields; exact crossing loci include non-generic three-sector coexistence at the deleted-matching boundary, and the extensive ground-state entropy doubles at the equal-bond manifold. A priori this requires resolving competing magnetization and pair-defect constraints, and provides a reproducible frustrated-spin finite-size benchmark. It is not a finite-table recomputation.
